classification: Authored adaptation using existing reference-classified poses

dribble.clock: Owned idle movement advances owner-local tick only; stationary resets to carry
dribble.ballPath: Continuous eased horizontal offsets -12,8,-20,-12; hand36 -> floor6 at tick9 -> hand36
dribble.event: One dribble event at phase9 per18ticks

offBallGait.advance: One pose per10.8 world units travelled; actor offsets prevent synchronized running
offBallGait.limits: Repurposed dribble poses, not a recovered dedicated off-ball run/backpedal set

dunk.owned: Gather before age15; contact after age15
dunk.released: Contact above height20, landing recovery below; physical descent continues during restart
dunk.limits: Authored thresholds; no recovered native holds

landing.block: Overhead while high; land-recover late descent; neutral after action recovery
landing.receive: Owned ball uses ready/carry; unowned receive uses landing/neutral

effects.shadows: Generated ground-plane ellipses; athlete shadow shrinks with elevation
effects.scoreCallout: 55 simulation ticks; does not stop or change rules

remainingGaps: Dedicated off-ball sprint and direction-specific defensive slides
